item.title: Asking Eric: Introduction of a child changes dynamic for longtime housemates
item.description: This week, Asking Eric advises a woman whose peaceful home life was disrupted by her housemate's sudden custody of a grandchild. Also, a widow shares her heartbreak after being shut out of funeral arrangements by her late husband’s family, and Eric discusses how to reclaim peace after such deep disrespect.

item.title: Today in History: US hockey team beats USSR in ‘Miracle on Ice’
item.description: On Feb. 22, 1980, the “Miracle on Ice” took place at the Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, New York, as the U.S. Olympic hockey team upset the Soviet Union, 4-3. (The U.S. team went on to win the gold medal two days later, 4-2, over Finland.)
